svg.title: Episode 4, The Hollow Sky: the nine plans
svg.desc: Schematic top-down plans of the nine maps of Episode 4: the idea of each plan, not cell layouts.
svg.text: EPISODE 4: THE HOLLOW SKY - the nine plans
schematic top-down plans: the SHAPE of each map, not its cells. Sizes, counts and every number are first guesses (design/EPISODE4.md).

g.text: a snail road round the cable, sky between the turns
three wrecks, each its own plan; the gaps are the level
a wheel: hub, ring, four bays open to the dark
a round glass hall; light runs the grid, mirrors turn it
the glass is gone here: open sky
a bubble of floating islands round one great tree
a funnel of five ranks; the Gate's light at the narrow end
a drum round a shaft of light; four landings, four fights
gold = a mirror: it turns the sweep onto a seal
an oval with a sunken ring; the Warden stands in the arch
the stone, the voice, a cache
a round window onto the stars above
one round room, stepped down to a stone

svg.text: dashed arrow = a vent throw (low gravity) orange = a falling load gold line = a light beam blue hatch = vacuum white = the Gate
